chapter: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival: After-Night

quests.title: As Though Kissed by Dew

dialogue.t: Ah, compadre! A little birdie told me you went to Aisa Bathhouse last night!
I'm gettin' the crew together, and we're gonna go there to celebrate! You in?
But, we were just there...
Uh, yeah... But, I bet you were missin' a few people, yeah? Like Shinobu.. and Gorou... and, y'know... Ayato...
Basically, Boss heard about the trip, and now he really wants to go.
A—Anyway! Once you're done perusin', come find me, and we'll SOAK! IT! UP!
Oh, you didn't go to the hot springs?

dialogue.sit: Well now, I don't see you going either...

dialogue.t: ...We did go with the Boss, once. But then he got it into his head to start some sort of competition...
Um, I forgot. The only thing I remember is almost passing out from the heat...
Well? Ready to get your soak on?
Aww yeah! Next stop, Aisa Bathhouse!
Oh, compadre... Don't tell me the gaming bug's gotcha bad, like Akira and the others... I mean, the games are fun, but they'll still be there after a good soak!

dialogue.sit: Following Itto's constant nagging, you all head to Aisa Bathhouse once again...

dialogue.t: Hahaha! This has gotta be the hottest one! Let's see who can last the longest! Who's in?
Hehe, if you're that excited about it, how can I refuse?
Listen... This isn't a sauna...
Ahhh... so warm... *snore*
Hey, don't fall asleep in the tub!
Uh... My fur is so heavy. I almost feel dizzy...
Hahaha! If you can't handle the heat, Gorou, get out of the... tub!
Hey! Stop being so loud!
Heh, Itto is as energetic as ever.
It's not good to get distracted during a match, brother.
Whoa! This game is getting heated! What's your next move, {NICKNAME}? What do you two think?
Hm... I would take it slow, try to consolidate my advantage.
Or, you could be aggressive... taking a risk isn't a bad idea!
Oh? Very clever, {NICKNAME}! A decisive defeat... I concede! Now, based on the random draw earlier, the next player should be...
Ayaka! Have fun, you two.
Oh, uh... Okay! Go easy on me, {NICKNAME}...

dialogue.sit: (Ayato must have lost to me on purpose to give Ayaka more time to play... Always up to something, that one...)

dialogue.t: Boss! The Mikawa Flower Festival was a huge success for us! We had three times more visitors than usual!
Based on what we've made so far, I think we'll be able to make... this much!
That's great news! We might even beat Yae Publishing house this month...
Oh? You look pleased about something... Having a party without me?
Oh, hehe... It's nothing...
I forgot to share some good news with you...
Thirty percent of the proceeds from the festival have been transferred to Yae Publishing House. We're expecting record profit this month... Don't you think congratulations are in order?
What!?
W—Well, boss... I guess congratulations ARE in order... This is our 333rd time competing against Yae Publishing House in sales, and our best showing to date — second place!
Hehehe...
...May this be a night of sweet dreams for all.

quests.description: I know that sweet dreams are as fleeting as the morning dew. And yet…
